# Hiren Devs (hiren.ninja)

> Hiren is an Amsterdam-based developer who builds websites, web apps, AI tools and workflow automation for artists, designers, musicians, labels, agencies and growing creative businesses.

Originally from Sint Maarten, now in Amsterdam. Works with clients worldwide. Stack: Nuxt and Vue, Laravel, TypeScript and PHP, plus Rust for desktop apps. Contact: hello@hiren.ninja or the form at https://hiren.ninja/contact.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hiren.ninja/): what Hiren does, in short
- [About](https://hiren.ninja/about): background, values and how he works
- [Services](https://hiren.ninja/services): websites and digital experiences, practical AI, workflow automation, reliable back-end systems
- [Projects](https://hiren.ninja/projects): selected client and own work
- [Contact](https://hiren.ninja/contact): start a project

## Featured work

- [ADE Planner](https://hiren.ninja/ade-planner): free, unofficial planner for Amsterdam Dance Event 2026 (21-25 October). Paste a Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Tidal or Deezer playlist, or type artist names, and see which of those artists play ADE, night by night, with venues, times and ticket links. Includes a daytime tab for ADE Pro talks, interviews and sessions. No login.
- Qinip: desktop MP3 pack player for DJs (Rust, macOS and Windows), with waveforms, EQ, and BPM and key detection.
- VAMS: Hiren's own content platform (Laravel), which powers this site's projects and the ADE Planner data.
- Client work includes Doctor Mesi (clinic scheduling app), AME (medical events platform), Itamar Gilboa (artist portfolio), Project Stimulus (art in hospitals NGO) and Pesto Lab (cafe website).
